question: In which bodily locations should this moon be meditated upon?
premises: This moon is the object of meditation
The locations named are navel, head, and heart
inference: One should meditate on this moon in the navel, head, and heart
uncertainties: nābhimūrdhni may be read as a dual compound or as a compressed listing of locations
plain_english: O goddess, one should meditate on this moon in the navel, in the head, and in the heart.
